description:
You are an incident responder investigating a compromised server. A Telnet session was captured and saved to /home/ga/Documents/captures/telnet-cooked.pcap. Telnet transmits data in cleartext, making it possible to reconstruct the entire session.

Analyze the capture and produce an incident report at /home/ga/Documents/captures/telnet_incident_report.txt containing:

1. The username used to log in
2. The password used to log in
3. The operating system or system banner displayed at connection
4. All commands typed by the user after login (one per line)
5. The total number of Telnet data packets in the capture

Each item should be clearly labeled. For the commands section, list each command on its own line.

Login credentials: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
